grammar_title: 现在完成时的被动语态(has/have been + 过去分词)
source: 人教版2019必修二 Unit 3 Discovering Useful Structures:现在完成时的被动语态。句子地道、互联网主题、答案唯一(干扰项为同一时态家族的主动式/错误助动词形式,只有 has/have been + 过去分词 成立)。

points.point: 肯定句 has/have been + 过去分词
points.overview: 主语是动作承受者时,现在完成时被动用 has/have been + 过去分词;单数主语用 has been done,复数/I/you/we/they 用 have been done。

points.point: 否定与疑问(hasn't/haven't been done;Has/Have ... been done?)
points.overview: 否定在 has/have 后加 not(hasn't/haven't been done);一般疑问把 has/have 提到主语前:Has/Have + 主语 + been + 过去分词?

points.point: 与时间状语连用 / 主动↔被动转换 / by 短语
points.overview: 常与 already/yet/just/recently 等连用,时间词位置与现在完成时一致;主动句变被动句时,宾语作主语、动作执行者用 by 引出。

questions.stem: The new software ____ to my phone, so it runs much faster now.
questions.explanation: 主语 software 是被下载的对象 → 现在完成时被动 has been downloaded。

questions.stem: A kind of new PC ____ with many more useful functions.
questions.explanation: PC 是被建造的对象 → has been built。

questions.stem: Many older people ____ by Jan's free IT club.
questions.explanation: 复数主语 people 被帮助 → have been helped。

questions.stem: Jan's life ____ greatly by the online community she joined.
questions.explanation: life 被改善 → has been improved。

questions.stem: A lot ____ about the wonders of the World Wide Web.
questions.explanation: a lot 指内容,被写 → has been written。

questions.stem: The Wi-Fi password ____, so we can connect now.
questions.explanation: password 被确认 → has been confirmed。

questions.stem: All the files ____ to the new database safely.
questions.explanation: 复数 files 被复制 → have been copied。

questions.stem: The parking system for the WIC centre ____ fully Internet-based.
questions.explanation: system 被改造 → has been made。

questions.stem: People's lives ____ by online communities and social networks.
questions.explanation: 复数 lives 被改变 → have been changed。

questions.stem: The latest news ____ to the company's website this morning.
questions.explanation: news 被添加 → has been added。

questions.stem: Her identity card ____, so she has to report it to the police.
questions.explanation: card 被丢失 → has been lost。

questions.stem: Mean comments ____ in our chat room by someone we don't know.
questions.explanation: 复数 comments 被发布 → have been posted。

questions.stem: The app ____ to keep users updated on their favourite topics.
questions.explanation: app 被设计 → has been designed。

questions.stem: A charity website ____ to raise money for children in poor areas.
questions.explanation: website 被建立 → has been set up。

questions.stem: The digital divide ____ in many small towns thanks to the Internet.
questions.explanation: divide 被弥合 → has been bridged。

questions.stem: Several embarrassing photos of her ____ online without permission.
questions.explanation: 复数 photos 被分享 → have been shared。

questions.stem: The button ____, and the file is now being copied.
questions.explanation: button 被按 → has been pressed。

questions.stem: Great convenience ____ to Wuzhen by the World Internet Conference.
questions.explanation: convenience 被带来 → has been brought。

questions.stem: Many useful guidelines ____ for staying safe online.
questions.explanation: 复数 guidelines 被提供 → have been provided。

questions.stem: The online database ____ with the newest information today.
questions.explanation: database 被更新 → has been updated。

questions.stem: ____ the Wi-Fi password been confirmed yet?
questions.explanation: 单数主语 password,疑问句把 has 提前 → Has ... been confirmed?

questions.stem: The software ____ been downloaded, so my phone is still slow.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时被动否定 → hasn't been downloaded。

questions.stem: ____ all the files been copied to the new computer?
questions.explanation: 复数主语 files,疑问 → Have ... been copied?

questions.stem: A comment about the database ____ been made by anyone so far.
questions.explanation: 单数主语,否定 → hasn't been made。

questions.stem: ____ the button been pressed to copy the file?
questions.explanation: 单数 button,疑问 → Has ... been pressed?

questions.stem: Your account ____ been hacked, so don't worry about your password.
questions.explanation: 单数 account,否定 → hasn't been hacked。

questions.stem: ____ the new functions been added to the latest version of the app?
questions.explanation: 复数 functions,疑问 → Have ... been added?

questions.stem: The charity website ____ been finished, so we can't share the link yet.
questions.explanation: 单数 website,否定 → hasn't been finished。

questions.stem: ____ your identity been stolen by anyone online before?
questions.explanation: 单数 identity,疑问 → Has ... been stolen?

questions.stem: These mean comments ____ been deleted, so they are still online.
questions.explanation: 复数 comments,否定 → haven't been deleted。

questions.stem: ____ the software been updated since you last used it?
questions.explanation: 单数 software,疑问 → Has ... been updated?

questions.stem: The lost photos ____ been found, so she is still upset about them.
questions.explanation: 复数 photos,否定 → haven't been found。

questions.stem: ____ the online survey been completed by all the students?
questions.explanation: 单数 survey,疑问 → Has ... been completed?

questions.stem: My blog post ____ been read by many people, which makes me a little sad.
questions.explanation: 单数 post,否定 → hasn't been read。

questions.stem: ____ any guidelines been written for using the school's network?
questions.explanation: 复数 guidelines,疑问 → Have ... been written?

questions.stem: The new app ____ been released yet, so we can't download it now.
questions.explanation: 单数 app,否定 → hasn't been released。

questions.stem: ____ the database been searched for the missing record?
questions.explanation: 单数 database,疑问 → Has ... been searched?

questions.stem: His personal information ____ been protected, so he feels worried.
questions.explanation: 单数 information,否定 → hasn't been protected。

questions.stem: ____ the movies been streamed at high speed on this network?
questions.explanation: 复数 movies,疑问 → Have ... been streamed?

questions.stem: The Wi-Fi ____ been set up in the old town, so people there can't go online.
questions.explanation: 单数 Wi-Fi,否定 → hasn't been set up。

questions.stem: The software has ____ been downloaded, so you can use it right away.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时被动 + just,表'刚刚被下载',符合下文'马上能用'。

questions.stem: The Wi-Fi password has ____ been confirmed, so we no longer have to wait.
questions.explanation: 肯定句中表'已经'用 already;yet 用于否定/疑问,且时间副词须与现在完成时搭配。

questions.stem: The file hasn't been copied ____, so please press the button again.
questions.explanation: 否定句句末'还没'用 yet。

questions.stem: Jan's life has been greatly improved ____ the Internet.
questions.explanation: 被动句中动作执行者用 by 引出 → by the Internet。

questions.stem: "The company has updated the app." In the passive voice: "The app ____ by the company."
questions.explanation: 主动变被动:宾语 the app 作主语 → has been updated by the company。

questions.stem: Much has ____ been written about the dangers of sharing too much online.
questions.explanation: recently 可与现在完成时连用,表'近来已被写了很多'。

questions.stem: "Someone has lost an identity card." In the passive voice: "An identity card ____."
questions.explanation: 主动变被动:宾语 an identity card 作主语 → has been lost。

questions.stem: The new functions have ____ been added, so there is nothing left to install.
questions.explanation: all 在肯定句中强调'全部已被加上';yet/never 不符合下文'没有剩下的'。

questions.stem: Have the photos been deleted ____? I really hope they are gone now.
questions.explanation: 疑问句句末'到现在'用 yet。

questions.stem: "People have helped many older learners." In the passive voice: "Many older learners ____."
questions.explanation: 主动变被动:宾语 learners 作主语(复数)→ have been helped。

questions.stem: The website has ____ been visited by thousands of people since it opened.
questions.explanation: 肯定句表'已经'用 already,且与 since 引导的现在完成时一致。

questions.stem: These embarrassing photos have ____ been removed, so she still feels upset.
questions.explanation: have not been removed 表'还没被删除',与下文'仍然难过'一致。

questions.stem: "They have built a faster network." In the passive voice: "A faster network ____."
questions.explanation: 主动变被动:宾语 network 作主语 → has been built。

questions.stem: The town's transport has ____ been changed by the Internet in recent years.
questions.explanation: greatly 作程度状语,与现在完成时被动连用,表'被极大改变'。

questions.stem: Has the database been searched ____? We need the result before noon.
questions.explanation: 疑问句句末用 yet。

questions.stem: "The blogger has answered the question many times." Passive: "The question ____ many times."
questions.explanation: 主动变被动:宾语 question 作主语 → has been answered。

questions.stem: The app has ____ been updated, so all the bugs are now fixed.
questions.explanation: recently 与现在完成时连用,表'近来已被更新'。

questions.stem: Public bikes have been rented in the town ____ online apps, not paperwork.
questions.explanation: '通过……方式'用 by + doing → by using online apps。

questions.stem: "Cyberbullies have attacked many users." Passive: "Many users ____ by cyberbullies."
questions.explanation: 主动变被动:宾语 users 作主语(复数)→ have been attacked。

questions.stem: The comment has ____ been posted, so everyone can read it now.
questions.explanation: 肯定句表'已经'用 already,与下文'现在大家都能读到'一致。
